jobs.description:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.

As Manager of our Pooled Customer Success team, you will lead a team of 4 to 7 Customer Success Managers who share collective ownership of a large portfolio of customers. Your mandate is to build a high performing team that delivers consistent, measurable value across many accounts without the a named one to one relationship.

This is a different discipline from named account management. Success here comes from designing repeatable plays, prioritizing the right customers at the right moment, maintaining clean account context so any CSM can pick up any customer, and holding the team to response and follow through standards that protect retention at volume.

You are both an operator and a hands on coach. You build the coverage system, you improve it every quarter, and you develop CSMs who can move quickly, diagnose accurately, and create value in a compressed number of touchpoints.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 4 to 7 pooled CSMs supporting a shared customer portfolio.

* Manage workload distribution, queue coverage, and capacity across the team so no customer segment goes unattended.

* Conduct regular portfolio reviews, renewal and risk reviews, and performance check ins.

* Coach CSMs on rapid discovery, efficient customer conversations, and getting to value in fewer, higher quality interactions.

* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

* Hire, onboard, and develop CSM talent suited to a fast moving, high volume environment.

* Driving Measurable Customer Value at Scale

* Operationalize our Customer Value Framework through standardized plays rather than bespoke plans.

* Ensure every customer in the pool receives defined lifecycle coverage, including onboarding confirmation, adoption checkpoints, and a structured pre renewal review.

* Establish clear value milestones and outcome criteria that apply consistently across the portfolio.

* Ensure product adoption is connected to tangible business results in every customer facing interaction.

* Monitor portfolio health signals and direct team effort toward the accounts where intervention changes the outcome.

**Retention, Expansion & Growth Alignment**  

* Own retention performance for the pooled portfolio, including renewal readiness and early risk detection.

* Partner closely with Renewals and Sales leadership on renewal strategy and expansion routing.

* Ensure CSMs surface new use cases, new stakeholders, and expansion signals and hand them off cleanly.

* Influence retention strategy through data driven insights and repeatable risk mitigation plays.

* Operational Excellence & Scalability

* Define and enforce the operating rhythm for the pool, including coverage standards, response expectations, escalation paths, and handoff protocols.

* Ensure documentation discipline so that account context lives in the system, not in individual memory, and any CSM can serve any customer.

* Ensure CRM and CS tooling reflect accurate account health, engagement history, and renewal status.

* Use metrics such as coverage rate, time to first response, adoption, health scores, renewal rates, and expansion ARR to drive performance conversations.

* Identify automation and process improvements that increase capacity without increasing headcount.

* Cross Functional Leadership

* Serve as the voice of a large and diverse customer population internally while balancing business priorities.

* Partner with Support, Product, Professional Services, Renewals, and Sales to improve the customer journey for customers who do not have a dedicated resource.

* Surface systemic risks, adoption blockers, and product feedback trends to senior leadership, using the volume of the pool as an early warning system for the broader base.

* Contribute to strategic planning for the broader Customer Success organization.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, including:

* 3+ years in Customer Success or account management

* 2+ years managing or leading CSM teams

* Experience operating a pooled, shared, or scaled coverage model, or a demonstrated ability to build one.

* Strong understanding of renewal strategy, retention management, and risk identification at volume.

* Proven ability to design and improve repeatable plays, playbooks, and operating standards.

* Comfort managing through systems and data rather than through individual account relationships.

* Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to translate portfolio signals into prioritized team action.

* A leadership style grounded in transparency, ownership, and high standards.

The Payment Integrity Inpatient Program Manager is responsible for overseeing assigned inpatient Payment Integrity programs, including audit, appeals, quality, and review processes across internal teams, offshore staff augmentation, and external vendors. This role is heavily focused on ensuring audit accuracy, timeliness, coding and clinical quality, regulatory compliance, consistency, and defensibility across all assigned program areas. The Program Manager is accountable not only for the quality of audit determinations but also for ensuring audits are reviewed within SLA and that inventory is actively managed to prevent backlogs.

* Perform complex and escalated inpatient Payment Integrity audits, including clinical validation, DRG coding validation, readmission, and hospital bill audit reviews, and provide clear, defensible audit rationale and determinations.

* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex audit, coding, clinical, and escalation-related issues, serving as the primary subject matter expert for assigned program areas

* Support the implementation of new audit concepts, review methodologies, and program enhancements to align with evolving business and regulatory needs

* Experience collaborating across clinical, coding, audit, and operational teams in a complex healthcare environment
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess audit trends, root causes, and documentation gaps impacting program performance and quality outcomes
* Strong operational discipline and the ability to stay organized amidst a wide variety of responsibilities
* Proven experience in training payment integrity audits

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage internal and external stakeholders
* Experience managing offshore vendors
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Curiosity and hands-on experience with AI tools, automation, or LLM-based workflows in operational settings

jobs.description:
**About Upstart**

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**The Team:**

Upstart’s **Partner Implementation & Enablement** team is responsible for bringing new bank and credit union partners onto our platform and keeping existing partners equipped to run their lending programs. We own the operational core of the partner relationship: the diligence materials partners use to evaluate us, the change management process that tells them when our policies and models change, and the systems that deliver both. How quickly a partner can launch, and how much confidence they have in us once they have launched, is decided by this team’s work.

As the **Diligence Program Lead** at Upstart, you will own the diligence and change management programs our lending partners depend on. You will answer the due diligence questionnaires that partners and their examiners require, maintain the document library and access controls behind them, and run the recurring process that notifies partners when our policies, procedures, and models change. You will work across Compliance, Lending Partnerships, Account Management, and Product to turn a set of manual, individually held processes into programs that hold up as the partner base grows.

**How you’ll make an impact**

* Own the lending partner change management program end to end: assemble each release, notify partners of policy, procedure, and model updates, and keep the supporting document libraries current.
* Respond to lending partner due diligence questionnaires and information requests, working with Compliance, Legal, and Model Risk Management to source and verify every answer.
* Maintain the partner-facing document repository and its access controls, including which materials each partner can reach based on their product mix and stage in the relationship.
* Run the recurring corrective action reporting cycle: validate the source data, distribute partner-specific reports, and confirm delivery with the teams that publish them.
* Work with Product to move manual diligence and change management workflows onto supported tooling, and document each process so more than one person can run it.
* Identify gaps in policy ownership and documentation approval status, and raise them with Compliance and Lending Partnerships before they reach a partner.

**Minimum Qualificationsu**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
* 5 years of experience in financial services compliance, risk, audit, or third-party due diligence
* 2 years of experience responding to due diligence questionnaires, regulatory examinations, or audit requests from banks, credit unions, or other regulated institutions
* Experience owning a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, including its documentation
* Experience administering a document management system, virtual data room, or other controlled-access content repository

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of consumer lending products and the policies that govern them, including personal loans, auto, and home equity
* Knowledge of model risk management practices and how model documentation is shared with third parties
* Knowledge of third-party risk management expectations at banks and credit unions
* Skilled in using generative AI tools to draft, verify, and maintain large volumes of written documentation
* Ability to build process automation in spreadsheet or workflow tools and hand it off to others to run
* Ability to influence across compliance, legal, product, and commercial teams without direct authority

**Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote

**Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

jobs.title: Regulatory Program Manager, UAS Part 135 Operations
jobs.description:
About Beeline UAS

Beeline UAS is an FAA Part 135 air carrier operating drone delivery for enterprise and healthcare partners across the United States. We are opening new metropolitan operating areas. Our team is small, senior, and built by regulatory experts. If you want to help write the rules for how aircraft without pilots on board become part of everyday life, this is the place.

The Role

You manage the regulatory programs that let Beeline fly new aircraft in new cities. Each program is a set of FAA filings, manual revisions, and agency conversations that must land in the right order. You own that plan end to end, keep every deliverable tight and on schedule, and become the person our FAA counterparts trust to get it right the first time. This role reports to the CEO and is remote (U.S.) or based in Bend, OR, with some travel to operating areas.

What You Will Do

* Manage certification programs for new aircraft and operating areas, from preapplication through FAA acceptance, including exemption petitions, Operations Specifications, and Part 135 certificate actions.
* Build and track integrated schedules across FAA Flight Standards, environmental review, and aircraft manufacturer partners.
* Draft, revise, and control company manuals and programs (operations, training, maintenance, hazardous materials, SMS) so submissions contain exactly what the governing requirement calls for.
* Run recurring compliance reporting: monthly operations reports, C2 link reports, and event and investigation reports to the FAA.

The Senior Operations Project Manager serves as the primary operational link between NAS leadership, Project Managers, field teams, and customers. The role is accountable for ensuring projects are properly planned, staffed, launched, executed, measured, and closed while meeting customer requirements, safety standards, quality expectations, financial targets, and contractual obligations.

This position requires a hands-on leader who can manage multiple projects, Operations Managers, and Field Teams across different locations and service lines while maintaining consistent NAS operating standards.

* Provide direct leadership, coaching, and operational oversight to NAS Operations Managers across assigned projects and service lines.
* Establish clear expectations, priorities, responsibilities, and performance standards for Operations Managers.

* Support Operations Managers and Field Supervisors with issue resolution, resource planning, customer escalations, and operational decisionmaking.
* Ensure Operations Managers maintain accurate project documentation, reporting, timekeeping, staffing records, training records, and customer deliverables.
* Develop consistent project management practices and operating standards across NAS locations.

* Overspray Services: Vehicle inspections, contamination assessment, overspray removal, quality verification, production tracking, and customer reporting.
* Workforce Solutions: Staffing programs supporting customer operations, including workforce planning, recruiting coordination, onboarding, scheduling, productivity management, attendance, and performance.
* Automotive Services: Vehicle inspection, repair campaigns, rework, accessory installation, paint and body repair, hail damage repair, yard services, quality campaigns, and other OEM or logisticsrelated services.
* Agriculture Equipment / High and Heavy Services: Inspection, repair, modification, campaign, processing, yard, and related services supporting agricultural, construction, and other high and heavy equipment.

jobs.title: Operations Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Operations ManagerLead the People, Processes, Systems, and Performance Behind a Growing Immigration Law Firm**

MRA Law Group is seeking an experienced, hands-on **Operations Manager** to lead the day-to-day performance, accountability, systems coordination, and continuous improvement of our Operations Department.

This is a leadership role for someone who knows how to turn expectations into execution.

The Operations Manager will oversee the operational teams responsible for supporting our clients, attorneys, and case production functions, from the first phone call through ongoing client communication, administrative support, document handling, internal operational requests, and systems-related execution.

We are looking for someone who can manage people, build accountability, analyze performance, improve processes, coordinate systems support, solve problems, and create an Operations Department that runs consistently without requiring constant intervention from senior leadership.

**What You Will Own**

**Operations Leadership & Team Management**

You will provide leadership and accountability across the Operations Department, including:

* Operations Team Lead
* Telephone Receptionist Team Lead and Receptionists
* Client CARE Team Lead and Client CARE Agents
* Virtual Assistant
* In-Office Administrative Assistant
* In-Office Legal Assistant
* Systems Administrator
* Systems Developer

You will establish clear expectations, ensure accountability, coach leaders and team members, identify performance issues early, and ensure the department has the structure, workflows, tools, and resources necessary to perform effectively.

You will be expected to manage both people and execution. This includes ensuring that team leaders are leading, frontline employees are meeting expectations, and systems-related support is helping the firm operate faster, cleaner, and more efficiently.

**Operational Performance & Accountability**

You will:

* Establish, monitor, and manage departmental and individual KPIs.
* Review daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly operational performance.
* Hold team leaders accountable for the performance of their respective teams.
* Identify performance trends, bottlenecks, capacity issues, recurring problems, and operational risks.
* Develop corrective action and coaching plans when performance falls below expectations.
* Ensure operational audits are completed and identified issues are addressed.
* Build an environment where ownership, follow-through, and accountability are part of everyday operations.

The current Operations framework measures department efficiency, workflow effectiveness, error reduction, client communication compliance, client satisfaction, complaints, procedure compliance, system usage, documentation accuracy, team KPI achievement, audits, issue-resolution time, process improvement, and operational risk identification.

**Systems, Technology & Operational Infrastructure**

The Operations Manager will play a key leadership role in ensuring the firm’s systems support the way the business actually needs to operate.

You will oversee the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer to ensure that systems, workflows, automations, reports, user access, troubleshooting, and technology improvements are properly prioritized and executed.

You will:

* Ensure operational systems are being used consistently and correctly.
* Translate operational needs into clear systems requirements.
* Coordinate with the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer on workflow improvements, automation opportunities, reporting needs, and system-related issues.
* Ensure system changes are aligned with operational goals and do not create unnecessary disruption.
* Monitor system usage, documentation accuracy, and compliance with required workflows.
* Identify gaps between process design, system capability, and actual team execution.
* Help prioritize technology improvements based on business impact, urgency, and scalability.
* Ensure systems-related projects are completed with clear ownership, timelines, testing, rollout, and follow-through.

This role does not require the Operations Manager to be a programmer. However, it does require someone who can understand operational problems, ask the right questions, manage systems-related priorities, and ensure technology supports performance instead of becoming another bottleneck.

**Client Experience**

Our Operations Department plays a major role in how clients experience MRA Law Group.

You will ensure:

* Client calls and communications are handled professionally and promptly.
* Reception and Client CARE teams consistently meet service expectations.
* Client concerns are identified, documented, and escalated appropriately.
* Communication breakdowns do not become preventable client complaints.
* Operational issues contributing to cancellations, dissatisfaction, or refund exposure are identified and addressed.
* Client feedback and satisfaction trends are monitored and converted into practical operational improvements.

**Processes & Continuous Improvement**

We do not want someone who simply maintains existing processes. We want someone who asks:

**Why are we doing it this way, is it working, and can we do it better?**

You will:

* Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve SOPs and workflows.
* Ensure consistent use of the firm’s case management system, trackers, and operational tools.
* Ensure tasks, communications, and activities are properly documented.
* Identify unnecessary steps, duplicated work, bottlenecks, process gaps, and ownership gaps.
* Translate operational problems into practical, measurable solutions.
* Implement improvements and measure whether they actually worked.
* Identify operational risks before they become larger client, legal, financial, or business problems.

The right person for this role will not treat process improvement as theory. You should be able to move from observation to diagnosis, fro

**Scope:**

The Operations Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the daily activities of the Operations Support Specialist team while driving operational excellence across the organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert in health plan administration, TPA operations, and self-funded employer health plans. The Operations Manager ensures operational processes are executed efficiently, supervises team performance and workflow, and leads program-level projects focused on continuous improvement, scalability, and service delivery enhancement.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience working within a Third-Party Administrator (TPA), health plan, or employer benefits environment and demonstrate the ability to interpret and apply benefits plan documents, including Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), plan documents, and related health plan materials

**Education:**

* HS Diploma required; Bachelor’s degree Preferred

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 5 years working in Health Plan Benefits Administration
* 2 Years of Management experience preferred

**Requirements/Skills:**

* Proven experience in an operations or supervisory role
* Proficiency in Microsoft office applications; Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams
* TPA and Health Plan Administration Experience
* Ability to understand Health Plan Design
* Ability to learn and utilize internal applications.
* Strong interpersonal communication skills.
* Awareness of internal and external customer needs.
* Knowledge of insurance, self-funded, and stop loss industry.
* Self-motivated, and ability to see projects through to execution.
* Strong trouble shooting and problem-solving skills.
* Good organizational skills and time management
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to handle difficult situations tactfully and diplomatically.
* Effective problem solving and decision-making skills.

* Provide coaching, training and feedback to staff to improve competence and productivity.
* Monitor and Analyze workload distribution and ensure timely completion of operational tasks.

The Event Operations Manager is responsible for planning, producing, and executing operational components for assigned endurance events across the Ventures Endurance Events portfolio. This role supports events from initial planning and permitting through onsite execution and post-event closeout, working closely with cross-functional teams, vendors, municipalities, and internal stakeholders.
  
  
This role is primarily remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near the Chicago region due to event density, operational needs, and proximity to the Ventures Endurance Events office and warehouse. While day-to-day work may be performed remotely, team members are expected to work from the office and/or warehouse as business needs dictate, including collaboration, planning sessions, event preparation, inventory management, and other operational activities. The Event Operations Manager reports to the Sr. Manager, Event Operations and supports multiple brands and event types across the organization. Travel and weekend work are required.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Plan, produce, and execute operational components for assigned events from contract execution through post-event closeout.
* Manage race-related operational elements including timelines, site plans, course layouts, public safety plans, and parking plans.
* Oversee event course and site layout development, load-in/load-out, and onsite execution.
* Manage onsite event inventories including equipment, branding, collateral, registration materials, and volunteer supplies.
* Secure and document required permits and approvals in coordination with internal leadership.
* Prepare and submit accurate documentation, maps, and supporting materials to municipalities, agencies, and partners.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with local jurisdictions, public agencies, and third-party partners.
* Conduct vendor and contractor outreach, quote analysis, negotiation, and management before, during, and after events.

jobs.title: Junior Project Coordinator (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**About Scale**
---------------

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-driven **Junior Project Coordinator** to keep our creative and development teams moving. You'll own weekly sprint planning for our Design team, keep tickets moving by following up with stakeholders, and keep our project management workspace in Wrike accurate and up to date.

This is a great entry-level opportunity for someone looking to grow in project coordination. You'll work closely with designers, developers, and project managers, gaining hands-on experience with sprint planning and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

This is a fully remote, part-time, standalone role at 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Pacific. You'll report to Krystal Perez, Project Manager, and support our Design and Software Development teams as well as our Project Managers. Within your first 60 days, you'll run the weekly sprint review independently and manage stakeholder follow-ups with minimal oversight.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Design Sprint Planning & Prioritization (Core Focus)**

* Build and prioritize the Design team's weekly sprint using established guidelines.
* Check in with each designer at the end of every week to confirm what's complete, what's carrying over, and why.
* Lead a weekly call with brand project managers to review sprint priorities and discuss tickets planned for upcoming sprints.

### **Stakeholder Follow-Up & Blocker Management**

* Follow up with ticket stakeholders when work is blocked by slow reviews, open questions, or missing information.
* Schedule touch-base calls at the start of a sprint for design tickets that need more detailed alignment beyond the brief.
* Escalate to your manager when a mission-critical item is still at risk, or when a ticket has had no movement for 3 to 4 days.
* Provide the same follow-up and escalation support for Software Development tickets.

### **Daily Ticket Assignment**

* Assign daily quick-turn tickets to the two designated designers, following a documented SOP.
* Confirm each ticket has the details a designer needs before it's assigned.

### **Project Manager Support**

* Help project managers build out new key projects in Wrike, including tasks, timelines, assignees, and fields.

### **Wrike Maintenance & Data Quality**

* Keep Wrike accurate and organized by updating statuses, cleaning up stale or duplicate items, and filling in missing fields.
* Help build out the Wrike onboarding space currently in development, including organizing resources and how-to content.
* Review new requests for missing information and send them back to requesters before they reach the team.

### **Reporting & Data Cleanup**

* Clean up monthly ticket data used for team productivity and workload reporting, and follow up with stakeholders on any missing information.
* Spot-check dashboards and automated status updates to confirm they're pulling correctly.
* Draft routine internal updates, reminders, and announcements for review.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Follow-Through:** Tracks open items to resolution and follows up independently.
* **Proactive Communication:** Seeks clarification at the start of a task and flags blockers or deadline risks as soon as they arise.
* **Responsiveness:** Replies promptly to Slack messages and Wrike comments during working hours.
* **Accuracy:** Keeps due dates, assignees, statuses, and ticket details correct and current.
* **Professional Communication:** Writes clear, polished, and concise messages to stakeholders at all levels.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* A bachelor's degree with at least one administrative, coordination, or project support internship, or 1 to 2 years of administrative experience.
* Hands-on experience with a project management tool such as Wrike, Asana, Monday.com, Jira, ClickUp, or Trello.
* Polished, professional written communication, especially in Slack and project management tools.
* A proven habit of following up independently and meeting deadlines.
* Comfort asking questions and raising blockers early.
* Availability to work 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Pacific, Monday to Friday.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with Wrike specifically.
* Experience supporting creative, design, marketing, or software development teams.
* Familiarity with agile or sprint-based workflows.
* Comfort with Google Workspace, Slack, and basic spreadsheet work like sorting, filtering, and cleaning data.

**What We Offer**

* Salary: $25 per hour
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Fully remote, full-time position
* Monthly work-from-home stipend
* Generous paid time off program
* Discounted products
* An amazing team to work alongside

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations team manages payroll processing and services across 80+ countries around the world. As Rippling continues expanding globally, we are looking for a hyper-focused, customer-obsessed Escalations Lead to serve as our primary champion for customer experience when critical issues arise. This role is driven by a desire to make rapid, lasting improvements that immediately impact the experience of both our largest enterprise accounts and our smallest growing businesses.

You are part technical detective and part cross-functional project manager. When sticky, high-friction problems hit, you jump straight into action, unraveling complex scenarios into actionable components. You possess a deep understanding of our product behavior, thrive on rigorous root-cause analysis, and are relentless about driving end-to-end fixes alongside R&D counterparts, internal ops, and cross-functional leadership. You build trust effortlessly with customers, communicate with exceptional clarity, and translate frontline operational friction into high-value product roadmap items.

This is a high-visibility opportunity offering deep exposure to global product operations and an immediate, direct impact on our product quality and customer retention.

**What you will do**

* **Own end-to-end management of executive escalations:** Serve as the subject-matter expert and drive resolution of complex, cross-functional problems. Orchestrate internal stakeholders to collaborate efficiently, demonstrating control and leadership in high-stakes situations. Communicate complex scenarios with simple, clear, and strategic written and verbal communications.
* **Customer Management and Communication:** Jump into high-stakes customer escalations to stabilize critical issues and build immediate trust. Deconstruct problems into crisp updates for our customers and internal stakeholders.
* **Project Manage Incidents:** Bring structure to high-friction situations by coordinating action plans, ownership, and cross-functional execution.
* **Root-Cause Analysis:** Unravel complex technical and operational issues into actionable components, leading RCAs to prevent recurrence. When an incident or customer escalation arises, you rapidly root cause the situation and develop a plan forward.
* **Analyze trends and root causes**: Conduct thorough root cause analysis on each escalation to identify trends and drive effective process improvement. Share trends analysis with executive leadership.
* **Partner directly with customers**: Engage with customers to navigate complex challenges, resolve critical issues, and strengthen their trust in Rippling’s products and services.
* **Drive End-to-End Fixes:** Partner relentlessly with R&D and Ops to deliver durable fixes and critical roadmap items

**What you will need**
----------------------

* **3+ Years Experience:** Escalations Management, TPM, Account Management, Strategic Customer Support, or Operations at a fast-growing tech company.

**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

This execution-oriented position will play a critical role in the realization of the Infrastructure & Commercial Product Group (ICPG) growth strategy. Supporting the full ICPG portfolio, this includes the coordination and project management of priority initiatives with an emphasis on commercial execution, process improvement and the effective adoption of GenAI tools.

This project manager will be relied upon for effective communication, including with senior team members, BU general managers and functional experts. Managing multiple initiatives simultaneously and without direct reports, a successful candidate will rely upon their ability to connect, influence and support colleagues within ICPG and across the broader organization to obtain successful project outcomes. Supported by an internal champion on each project, they will lead the appropriate resources through all phases of a project, including scoping, planning, execution, completion/hand-off and post-mortem process improvement. They will be relied upon to effectively communicate project status, risks, mitigation and timeline, contributing directly to progress and/or escalating as required to ensure project teams meet or exceed stated objectives. In parallel with project execution activities, this role will help to guide ICPG’s acceleration of GenAI adoption. This includes supporting the development of a GenAI roadmap (in concert with ICPG leadership) and the execution of priority GenAI implementation projects. Considered a vital component of ICPG’s growth strategy, it is expected that up to 50% of this role will be supporting the identification, justification and execution of projects in this dynamic space.

This role requires strong judgement, an openness to debate, the ability prioritize and a willingness to effectively navigate both ambiguity and conflict.

 **IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**

* Define project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with management, project sponsors, relevant functional experts and other stakeholders.

**Sales & Field Enablement**

* Ensure use cases are coherent, GTM-ready, and accessible across Sales teams, Marketing, and CS as functional tools, not just internal documentation
* Partner with Product Operations on the technical infrastructure required to support use case creation, storage, and distribution

====================

Ventas is a leading S&P 500 company enabling exceptional environments that benefit a large and growing aging population. With an enterprise value exceeding $50 billion and a portfolio of more than 1,400 properties across North America and the United Kingdom, Ventas is a preeminent participant in the longevity economy. * Attend weekly Owner, Architect, Designer calls across all larger investment projects

Coordinate and communicate with design and construction teams  



**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in project management in real estate, construction, or development

* Experience working with an owner/developer, general contractor, or a related entity—preferably in the healthcare industry

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without need for employer sponsorship now or in the future

jobs.title: Patient Engagement Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
Accompany Health is on a mission to give patients with complex needs the dignified, high-quality care they deserve but rarely receive. A primary, behavioral, and social care provider, Accompany Health walks alongside patients for their entire care journey, offering at-home and virtual care, as well as 24/7 support. Partnering with innovative payors, Accompany Health is powered by remarkable care teams, elegant technology, and a commitment to evidence-based practice.  
  
We build long-term relationships with our patients so they know, without question, that our team is here for them day or night, year after year. We focus on the health outcomes most important to our patients to make it clear that they lead the way.  
  
To achieve our mission, we collaborate with community-based organizations, local providers, and health plans. Led by our empathetic care teams, guided by proven care models, and powered by our own technology, we deliver a level of service that our communities rightfully deserve but rarely receive.  
  
While our headquarters is in Bethesda, MD, our teams are distributed across the country. If you're eager to make a tangible difference in people's lives, to help correct long-standing disparities in health care, join us.

***About the role:***

The Patient Engagement Coordinator plays a central role in ensuring that our patients receive consistent, high-quality engagement and are supported in maintaining their ongoing care.

This role will focus on reaching out to existing Accompany Health patients to schedule Annual Visits, follow-up appointments with clinicians, and provide gentle reminders, answer questions, and reinforce the value of our continuous support. Your work will help patients stay engaged with their care teams and build stronger relationships with us over time.

This is a high-volume outbound call role. You will spend the majority of your workday on back-to-back outbound calls, with a target of 135+ calls per day (subject to change as business needs evolve). Success in this role requires the ability to maintain energy, focus, and warmth across a full day of calls — this is not a role for someone who tires of phone work. Your success is measured by your ability to deliver an outstanding patient experience, ensure continuity of care, and maintain accurate records.

* **This role is a full-time, contract position, with an end date of 02/01/2027**

***Responsibilities will include:***

* Conduct outbound calls, texts, and other virtual outreach to schedule Annual Visits and follow-up appointments with existing patients
* Maintain a daily outbound call target of 135+ calls, working through structured call queues in our internal CRM tools throughout the day
* Send SMS and message-based outreach to patients to confirm appointments and follow up on scheduling
* Navigate and maintain records across internal CRM systems and spreadsheets simultaneously during and after calls
* Educate patients on the importance of ongoing care and the benefits of completing their annual visits and any necessary follow-up appointments with clinicians
* Handle calls from patients with warmth and professionalism, answering questions and directing them appropriately
* Collaborate closely with clinical care teams to ensure alignment on visit readiness and follow-ups
* Provide an empathetic, respectful, and encouraging patient experience on every call
* Monitor scheduling metrics and contribute to achieving engagement goals, maintaining both call volume targets and service quality
* Act as a liaison between patients and the care team to address basic concerns and questions about services

***What makes you a fit for the team:***

* Excellent communicator with a warm, patient-first mindset
* Empathetic listener who can connect with a wide variety of individuals, especially seniors and those with complex needs
* Comfortable with high-volume, structured call workflows, energized rather than drained by back-to-back outbound calls throughout the day
* + If you are not energized by the idea of making a high volume of calls every day, this role is not the right fit
  + We are looking for people who thrive in a structured, high-output environment and take pride in working through a full call queue while still delivering an exceptional patient experience
* Able to maintain warmth, professionalism, and energy across a full day
* Motivated by helping others succeed in their healthcare journey
* Able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-moving, remote-first environment
* Comfortable working across multiple tools simultaneously, including CRM systems, spreadsheets, and SMS platforms

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Required
* + High School Diploma/GED or higher
  + 2+ years of related experience in a high-volume outbound call environment, preferably in healthcare customer service or healthcare sales/direct marketing
  + Excellent patient communication skills, with the ability to quickly build trust and rapport with seniors and other patients
  + Strong computer skills and basic knowledge of G-Suite (e.g., Google Docs/Sheets)
  + Can handle multiple tasks at once, such as typing notes while talking and working in 2 systems at the same time
  + The first stage of the hiring process requires applicants to complete an internet speed test to ensure their connection meets the performance standards necessary for this position
* Preferred
* + Experience working in an Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system
  + Knowledge of Medicaid and/or Medicare programs and senior services
  + Ability to work after hours and weekends if needed

jobs.title: Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Health Coach
jobs.description:
Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

**The Role**

We’re hiring a Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Clinical Navigator (Health Coach) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

**Schedule**

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, with the following schedule options:

* **Central, Mountain, Arizona, or Pacific Time:** 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm
* **Eastern Time:** 9am to 6pm ET only

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.
* Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.
* Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.
* Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.
* Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.
* Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.
* Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

As our Customer Success Manager, you will align our goals with those of our clients, maximizing the value we transfer to each other. You will ensure that we understand our clients’ problems and needs, and that they understand and benefit from our software solutions. You will be in the center of a hexagon, moving information among internal and external expert stakeholders: P21 Business Leaders, Product Managers, and Clinical Data Consultants; and also client-side department heads, IT administrators, and end users.

Your challenge is to optimize the tradeoffs between each stakeholder’s respective goals: help P21 renew and expand contracts, communicate product features and user feedback, and meter out limited consulting resources; and also help clients get their preferred fixes and features on our roadmap, navigate the bureaucracy of version upgrades, and train many thousands of people to use our software well.

As the hub of vendor-client intelligence, you will be relied on to guarantee feature adoption and client business success—which should result in customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth, as well as direction for our product development efforts. Note: As the market leader, we have almost all the major clients that exist, and the pressure is real. You’ll be doing about four different jobs.

Responsibilities:

**Account Manager: Escort clients along their journey with us.**

* Serve as point of contact starting after initial sale and onboarding clients from their first install (implementation) to expanded use and later version upgrades (adoption).
* Build professional client relationships, facilitating online meetings and offline emails and tickets; follow or create scripts for standard steps in the client journey.
* Move clients through the admin steps surrounding installs and upgrades in tandem with our Implementation Managers and Technical Operations Teams; provide ongoing support for all clients, and extra care for those who are new and/or at-risk. *Note: Some of this extra care involves working beyond or outside of normal hours for clients who have emergencies, operate overseas, or require off-hours system maintenance.*

**Product Evangelist: Educate clients on our features and their intended use.**

* Study our documentation and experiment in our testing environments to learn our selling points, the differences between versions, and the steps for using each feature.
* Route clients through our knowledge libraries to circulate our marketing, training, and informational content, generating excitement and preempting FAQs.
* Represent our Product Managers and Clinical Data Consultants in training users in our intended use cases and supporting their adoption of our advanced features.
* Lure clients onto the latest version of our software by negotiating for their IT resources and articulating our value propositions. *Note: One challenge of your role will be to help clients time their upgrades amidst uncertain or delayed release schedules.*

**Customer Advocate & Communicator: Move key info between clients and our teams.**

* Research each client extensively, writing your findings in our CRM system and triaging which questions we should ask next; facilitate interviews with existing clients biweekly for premium accounts and annually for small pilot accounts.
* Document all discussions with pre-call agenda, post-call notes/minutes, and service desk tickets to track bug reports, feature ideas, or information requests; triage the resulting action steps based on client account size, urgency, and scalability of the solution.
* Escalate or deescalate issues wisely to direct the right staff to the right problem; kindly “remind” your peers to follow through with responses, either in the form of future code changes, temporary workarounds, or the production of more informational content. *Note: Another challenge of your role will be to hear clients’ problems and be able to communicate effectively with other P21 teams who are non-client facing to resolve client needs within timelines specified.*
* Find answers independently by troubleshooting bugs, shadowing our experts, and teaching yourself about our products; remain humble and know when to defer to an expert—which will be most of the time at first.

**Business Analyst: Ask good questions and listen to clients’ pain points.**

* Drive client satisfaction by tracking both stories and stats that show account health.
* Gather qualitative intel from direct observation of client environments and anecdotal evidence from routine interviews, e.g., pain points, nuances in their use cases, feedback on features, and opportunities for more training. *Note: We often go off script for our largest clients in helping them resolve emergencies, so it will be a challenge to promote long-term health while dealing with the short-term “crisis of the week.”*
* Gather quantitative intel from analysis of client click paths and usage metrics to identify patterns of (mis)use, interpreting these insights in light of their stories.
* Identify gaps and overlaps between clients’ existing processes and our intended use cases to advise their scope and sequence in adopting our solutions.

As a Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of property management customers and are responsible for their retention, satisfaction, and growth. We are growing, and customers are leaning on us more every year to help them get the most out of the platform, including our AI-driven features.  
  
**What you will do**  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for your customers and guide them through adoption and their overall success journey
* Keep customers with us by learning their goals and delivering solutions that meet them
* Spot churn risk early using AI-powered health signals, and prioritize outreach across your portfolio
* Run regular check-ins, business reviews, and product feedback sessions, and show customers new features and best practices
* Keep customer platforms up to date and well configured, and recommend changes that improve performance
* Help customers adopt AI-driven features in Track, and recommend automation that cuts manual work during business reviews
* Partner with Sales on renewals, contract negotiations, and expansion, with Support on Tier 3 escalations, with Professional Services on training and configuration, and with Product and Engineering by bringing customer feedback into discovery calls

  
**What you will bring**  

* Bachelor's degree and/or 3+ years of directly related experience
* Working knowledge of the vacation rental or short-term rental industry
* Experience working with executive-level clients
* Daily use of AI tools (like Claude, ChatGPT, or built-in platform AI) to increase your capacity and output quality. This is a must, not a nice-to-have.
* Ability to explain AI-driven product features in plain language to non-technical property managers and owners
* Strong communication, organization, and prioritization skills
* Project management experience is a plus

  
**You will thrive here if**  

* You can keep a full portfolio moving at once and decide who needs you most this week based on health signals, not just who emails loudest
* You are comfortable in a room with a vacation rental company's executives and can turn technical capabilities into practical wins for their properties
* You like being the connector between customers and our internal teams, and you follow through until the issue is resolved

  
**Compensation**  
The expected starting base salary range for this role is $65,000 to $75,000, plus eligibility for a 10% annual incentive tied to company performance. Final compensation is based on relevant skills, experience, education, and geographic location.

Our single-vendor ecosystem gives growing vacation rental companies the enterprise-class tools they need to scale, backed by 70+ integration partners, a growing suite of native features, and AI-driven tools that sharpen pricing, distribution, and guest communication. We combine deep hospitality expertise with forward-thinking technology and a customer-obsessed mindset to help property managers win.  
  
Track is proud to be named an Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Company in America and a People's Choice Award winner.  
  
**Our core values**

* Serve Others: nurturing growth to help others succeed
* Grit: taking ownership and never giving up on what matters most
* Create the Future: innovating to disrupt the status quo

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Care
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Manager, Customer Care is a frontline people leader responsible for the day-to-day performance, coaching, and operational execution of a team of Application Support Analysts who support one or more MoD products. This role drives consistent service delivery, manages escalations within the team, and champions a customer-first culture grounded in accountability and continuous improvement.  
  
The Manager works closely with Customer Care leadership to implement operational priorities, maintain SLO attainment, and develop ASA talent. This role is expected to apply AI tools and modern support practices to improve team productivity, knowledge quality, and customer outcomes. Reports to the Director, Customer Care.

**Job Description:**

In the USA, this job profile is **EXEMPT** and will be not eligible for paid overtime.

**Compensation Range:** The expected compensation range for this position is $110,000 - $120,000 annually, based on skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

  

**Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & People Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Application Support Analysts across assigned product lines
* Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and growth conversations with direct reports
* Set clear individual and team expectations aligned to Customer Care scorecards and SLOs
* Identify skill gaps and partner with the Director to develop targeted learning and development plans
* Foster a team culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement
* Support onboarding of new team members and facilitate structured knowledge transfer

**Operational Execution & Service Delivery**

* Monitor team queues and workload distribution to ensure timely resolution within published service levels
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex or high-priority customer issues within the team
* Investigate technical problems to determine root cause and coordinate resolution with Development and Product
* Identify patterns in support volume, recurring issues, and service gaps; develop and execute mitigation plans
* Ensure seamless customer transitions from implementation to steady-state support through active handover participation
* Maintain current knowledge of assigned MoD product lines and participate in release readiness activities

**AI & Operational Innovation**

* Actively use AI tools to improve personal effectiveness, accelerate root-cause analysis, and streamline documentation and communication workflows
* Identify and recommend opportunities to apply AI-assisted capabilities within the team (e.g., ticket deflection, knowledge base enrichment, response drafting)
* Champion adoption of approved automation, self-service, and knowledge management tools within the team
* Contribute to the Customer Care AI and innovation agenda by surfacing team-level use cases and outcomes to the Director

**Knowledge & Quality Management**

* Review and maintain the quality and accuracy of knowledge articles, community content, and documentation within assigned product areas
* Lead team efforts to create and update reusable troubleshooting resources, reducing time-to-resolution and support dependency
* Reinforce consistent application of support best practices and quality standards across the team
* Identify and document recurring product issues to support Development and Product prioritization

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Development and Product teams to facilitate issue resolution, communicate support trends, and contribute to product improvement
* Partner with the Customer Engagement & Adoption team to support at-risk account interventions and coordinated customer outcomes where applicable
* Participate in user group seminars, webinars, and customer-facing sessions to strengthen product knowledge and customer relationships
* Contribute to the enhancement request process by surfacing customer feedback and team observations to Product leadership

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of progressive experience in technical customer support or customer care environments
* 2+ years of direct people management experience, including performance management and coaching
* Demonstrated ability to manage team workload, service levels, and escalations in a fast-paced, mission-critical support environment
* Experience identifying and implementing process improvements that improve team productivity and service quality
* Actively applies AI tools (e.g., large language models, AI-assisted writing, workflow automation) in day-to-day work; committed to expanding AI fluency as the capability evolves
* Comfortable championing AI-assisted practices within a team and coaching others through adoption
* Familiarity with modern support platforms, CRM systems, and knowledge management tools
* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex technical issues
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; effective working across teams and with customers
* Working knowledge of MoD-specific products or comparable transit/paratransit software preferred
* Bachelor's degree in a related discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Transit, paratransit, or public sector technology experience an asset
* Proficiency in CRM systems and MS Office applications
* Willingness to travel to customer sites, user groups, and management meetings (estimated 10% of work year)
* Availability for after-hours on-call support as needed

Regular

**DISCLAIMER: There may be incorrect openings posted on third party websites. Be advised that all of our current openings are posted on our** **Careers** **page - check that out to stay in the know!**

**About Us**

Stocktwits is a leading social network and community of individual investors and traders. Our mission is to provide the platform to host the global conversation for investors and traders of all types of assets, styles and experience levels to connect, learn, profit and have fun.

From our beginnings as inventors of the cashtag (e.g. $TSLA), Stocktwits has grown to millions of members and become the defining voice of “social finance.” Stocktwits is the only place to get a pulse on the markets and ideas you care about.

Our community continues to grow rapidly and we are looking for passionate team members to join us as we reimagine the future of financial media, investing & trading services and the tools for the next generation.

**The Role**

A trusted environment is at the heart of our mission. As our Trust and Safety Community Manager, you will own the day-to-day operations that keep the Stocktwits community safe, supported, and informed. Your responsibilities will span community management, customer support, content and account moderation, and the operational handling of legal and privacy requests.

You will manage an external support team and own the internal tools and third-party software used for support and moderation. You will develop clear policies, train the team to apply them consistently, and communicate decisions to users with clarity and sound judgment.

This is a hands-on management role. You should be comfortable moving between team leadership, sensitive user escalations, software administration, policy writing, and cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, and legal counsel.

**What You’ll Do**

* Manage a 24/7 external support team of 6-8 members, including coaching, coverage, and performance.
* Own customer support operations, including queues, response standards, quality reviews, and complex user escalations.
* Oversee content and account moderation, user reports, enforcement decisions, and appeals.
* Manage the internal tools, third-party software, and vendor relationships used for support and moderation.
* Evaluate and improve AI-assisted moderation and support workflows, with appropriate human oversight.
* Write and maintain community guidelines, moderation policies, support procedures, and escalation playbooks.
* Communicate policies and enforcement decisions clearly and respectfully to users and internal teams.
* Own the operational handling of subpoenas, legal data requests, and privacy requests, including GDPR-related requests, in coordination with legal counsel.
* Monitor community activity and emerging abuse patterns, and share user feedback with Product and Engineering.
* Track support and moderation performance, improve processes, and coordinate responses to urgent community issues.

**What You’ll Need**

* 3+ years of professional experience managing online communities, with direct experience in customer support and/or content moderation.
* Experience managing a support or moderation team, including escalation, quality assurance, and performance management.
* Experience administering customer support platforms, moderation tools, or internal account management systems.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted content moderation or support tools, including their limitations and the importance of human oversight.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear policies, procedures, user communications, and internal documentation.
* Strong judgment when reviewing sensitive content, resolving disputes, and making decisions with incomplete information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain difficult decisions calmly and respectfully.
* Comfort owning legal and privacy request workflows in partnership with legal counsel, including handling sensitive information and tracking deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance daily operations with longer-term improvements.
* Ability to use operational data to identify problems, prioritize work, and measure results.
* Interest in financial markets and an understanding of the unique challenges facing online investing and trading communities.

**Benefits and Perks**

* A competitive salary
* Unlimited PTO and sick leave
* Remote-work flexibility
* Fully paid for comprehensive health care (medical, dental, vision)
* 401k with company match up to 4%.
* Stock options: You’ll have a meaningful stake in our success
* Generous WFH stipend

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including geographic location as well as candidate experience and expertise. If you have questions on compensation bands, please ask your recruiter.

We realize the full promise of diversity and want you to bring your whole self to work every single day.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world's top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (#12 out of 500).

jobs.title: Senior Tax Strategy Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior Tax Strategy Implementation Specialist  
**Holistic Tax Advisors | Fully Remote | Independent Contractor Opportunity**

Holistic Tax Advisors seeks an experienced tax professional to execute approved tax strategies for individuals and business owners.

**This is an implementation engagement. It does not include leading client advisory calls, managing client relationships, selling services, or independently developing and approving tax plans.**

Our advisory team owns strategy recommendations and client communication. You will own the assigned implementation work, from reviewing the approved plan through completing required actions, verifying supporting records, and delivering an organized handoff to the tax preparation team.

The engagement requires strong technical knowledge and proven hands-on execution experience. You must understand how strategies work in practice, recognize implementation problems, and know when to escalate an issue.  
Scope and Deliverables

* Convert approved strategies into implementation plans identifying prerequisites, tasks, responsible parties, deadlines, and completion requirements.
* Review client information for completeness and consistency; flag facts that may affect implementation.
* Prepare implementation forms, schedules, instructions, and supporting records within the agreed scope and your professional qualifications.
* Coordinate required actions with the firm’s advisory and preparation teams, bookkeepers, payroll providers, attorneys, financial professionals, and other providers.
* Give the client-facing team precise requests for documents, signatures, information, and client actions.
* Maintain accurate implementation records and written updates identifying completed work, outstanding dependencies, and issues requiring a decision.
* Verify required actions and supporting evidence before marking work complete.
* Deliver a documented handoff explaining what was implemented, relevant amounts and dates, outstanding items, and information needed for tax preparation.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation workflows and documentation.

If client facts conflict with the approved plan or a technical question requires a new advisory decision, pause the affected work and escalate it to the advisor.

**Experience and Qualifications**  
We are targeting professionals with:

* Five or more years of relevant U.S. tax experience, including at least three years personally implementing tax strategies. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.
* Proven execution experience with the strategy categories relevant to the assigned work, such as entity and election implementation, owner and family payroll, accountable plans, retirement-plan coordination, or real estate strategy implementation.
* Working knowledge of implementation requirements, substantiation, deadlines, and the connection between completed actions and tax return reporting.
* Experience coordinating multiple parties and managing implementation dependencies.
* Strong research, documentation, quality review, and written communication skills.
* Ability to deliver technically sound work independently within an agreed scope.

EA or CPA credentials are preferred. Credentials and job titles support, but do not replace, demonstrated implementation experience.

**AI and Automation**  
You should be comfortable using approved AI tools, workflow automation, and document systems to improve execution.

You must be able to:

* Review generated documents, calculations, and research for accuracy and applicability.
* Verify material tax conclusions against appropriate authority.
* Identify missing facts, unsupported assumptions, and incorrect outputs.
* Keep automated actions within the authorized scope and required approval checkpoints.
* Protect client information and use only approved systems for confidential data.
* Maintain records of material actions and human review.

You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of your deliverables.

**Remote Working Requirements**  
This engagement is fully remote. It requires a secure workspace, reliable connectivity, effective written collaboration, and compliance with the firm’s data security requirements.  
Scope, fees, deliverables, deadlines, coordination expectations, and acceptance criteria will be established in a written services agreement.

**Selection Process**  
Applicants should provide three examples of strategies they personally implemented, clearly distinguishing their work from work completed by others.

Finalists will complete a practical exercise using a fictional client scenario and discuss their approach, technical decisions, and completion evidence. Relevant employment history, credentials, and implementation experience will be verified, including through a reference who directly reviewed or supervised the work.

Do not submit confidential client information or proprietary employer materials.

Pay: $35.00 - $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 25.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* Do you have five or more years of relevant U.S. tax experience, including at least three years personally implementing tax strategies?
* Provide three examples of strategies you have personally implemented, clearly distinguishing your work from work completed by others.
* Tax Prep and Tax Strategy are not the same thing and we do not offer training. Tax Preparers assist when the tax year is over. Tax Strategists help clients strategize throughout the year. Please confirm you are a Tax Strategist, otherwise your application will be discarded.

jobs.description:
**Role summary**

We are hiring a part-time Sales & Operations Leader to run the sales and operations staff across three businesses: BICS (IT and analytics consulting), Evolve (digital marketing), and S&N Investment Properties (real estate). The people doing the work are already in place; this Leader keeps them on process, verifies execution, and drives revenue, close rate, and customer engagement heading into 2027.

**Job responsibilities**

· **Strategic execution:** Translate founder and leadership ideas into a defined objective, owner, next step, timeline, and practical measure of progress. Surface tradeoffs when priorities change.

· **Sales leadership and revenue operations:** Review HubSpot visibility, opportunity ownership, follow-up and stalled deals. Join selected sales calls to observe performance, give specific feedback, coach the sales team, and improve discovery and handoffs. The assigned salesperson remains accountable for the call and follow-up.

· **Marketing and outreach:** Drive marketing and outreach to existing BICS and Evolve clients and selected prospects. With no dedicated marketing team, define the audience, offer, message, channels and next steps; personally build or coordinate the materials and campaigns; and assess what generates useful conversations.

· **RFP and proposal leadership:** Review RFPs for fit, requirements, credibility and quality. Serve as the point person gathering relevant project examples, results, references, technical input and other source material from delivery and leadership so proposals are sufficiently supported. Coordinate revisions with the proposal writer and pursuit owner.

· **Cross-company coordination:** Connect people and decisions across BICS and Evolve when an initiative spans sales, marketing, delivery, finance, or administration. Identify work without a clear owner.

· **Onboarding and handoffs:** Coordinate the operational pieces of new team member and client onboarding, including access, documentation, role expectations and handoffs to the assigned owners. Confirm that outstanding setup steps have an owner and are completed.

· **Operational blocker resolution:** Act as the liaison among administrative, accounting, IT and other support staff to identify and resolve blockers. Bring the founder a concise decision or escalation when the issue exceeds the role’s authority or available resources.

· **Client engagement:** Maintain direct contact with clients when an introduction, relationship check-in, service concern, expansion conversation or cross-team coordination would help move work forward. Bring the appropriate sales or delivery owner into follow-up.

· **Operational improvement:** Assess workflows, staffing arrangements, tools, AI, and automation opportunities. Move approved changes into use with an owner, basic validation, and follow-through.

· **Delivery and PM enablement:** Partner with delivery leadership to strengthen handoffs, project visibility, and practical PM standards without creating a large training burden. Delivery leadership retains project and PM management.

**Required traits and skills**

· **Hands on:** Willing and able to do the work, learn unfamiliar technology, and build new tools or solutions when the business needs them.

· **Comfort with ambiguity:** Works from incomplete context, asks targeted questions, checks assumptions, and brings back a concrete recommendation rather than waiting for a complete brief.

· **Independent judgment and resilience:** Makes practical decisions with incomplete information, explains the reasoning, and remains steady when feedback changes the direction. Adjusts and keeps work moving without relying on the founder for every next step.

· **Commercial and technical fluency:** Understands a small technology services firm well enough to connect client needs, delivery capacity, proposals, CRM activity, and profitability. Deep engineering expertise is unnecessary.

· **Independent follow-through:** Tracks commitments, closes loops across contractors and teams, escalates blockers early, and adapts when circumstances change.

· **Pragmatic systems judgment:** Uses lightweight routines and selective automation to improve reliability without imposing unnecessary meetings, documentation, or software.

Pay: $50.00 - $75.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote
