new_jobs.title: Senior L&D Program Manager - Manager Programs
new_jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As Senior L&D Program Manager - Manager Programs, you will continue to develop and operate a best-in-class global Manager Development Program for Crusoe’s global manager population. This role is ideal for an experienced L&D strategist who moves quickly, thrives in fast-paced environments, and brings instructional precision, big-picture thinking, and operational excellence.

You will balance high-level strategy with hands-on execution—designing and facilitating manager experiences, curating learning journeys, and establishing data-driven feedback loops. Partnering directly with senior leaders across engineering, data center operations, manufacturing, and corporate teams, you will ensure our leaders are equipped to scale with Crusoe’s rapid growth.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Manager Program Facilitation & Iteration: Facilitate and continuously evolve Crusoe’s Manager Program (“Manager Bootcamp”), aligning content with company strategy, culture, and operational priorities.
* Manager Journey Curation: Build a cohesive, end-to-end development journey that connects managers to Crusoe’s mission, business model, and organizational impact.
* Modular & Functional Tracks: Partner with internal teams (HR / People, Talent Development, senior leadership) to build modular and team-specific development tracks tailored to technical, manufacturing, and data center operational teams.
* Program Operations & Metrics: Build robust measurement frameworks and feedback loops to evaluate program effectiveness, track leadership performance metrics, and optimize operational delivery.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with People, IT, Workplace, and business leaders to create seamless, high-touch manager experiences.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8–10+ Years of L&D Leadership: Proven track record in Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or Instructional Design, with explicit experience scaling manager programs inside technical, engineering, or industrial organizations.
* Technical Org Fluency: Deep understanding of how engineering, technical operations, and manufacturing leads operate, what motivates them, and how to build credibility in highly technical cultures.
* Data-Driven Approach: Expertise using workforce analytics and learning metrics to evaluate program ROI, identify performance risks, and justify strategic interventions.
* Program Execution: Equal parts strategic architect and hands-on builder; comfortable designing frameworks from scratch in ambiguous, fast-growing environments.
* Enthusiasm for Travel: Willingness and ability to travel to global offices, manufacturing sites, and data centers as needed (approx. 25% travel).

**Bonus Points**

* Organizational Development Background: Advanced grounding in adult learning theory or organizational effectiveness.
* Modern L&D Tech Stack: Hands-on familiarity with tools such as WorkRamp, Lattice, Confluence, or modern LMS/knowledge platforms.
* Infrastructure Tech Context: Genuine curiosity about AI systems, hardware manufacturing, and the physical data center infrastructure powering future technologies.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $160,000 - $195,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

---------------------

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

**Location: 4 on-site days a week in Sunnyvale, CA Headquarters.**
------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our Teams Vision:**
---------------------

Our team operates at the forefront of Zero Trust Segmentation, driving efficient growth and strategic partnerships with our key stakeholders. We are dedicated to building scalable infrastructure and optimizing our financial model to support Illumio’s ambitious business goals.

As we embark on a significant phase of growth, we welcome individuals who embody our values, consistently deliver excellence, and drive innovation. Join us in shaping the future of cybersecurity while advancing your career at Illumio, where every contribution counts towards our collective success.

We are seeking a motivated, curious, and detail oriented individual to join our Sales Operations team as an ADR Operations Analyst. This is an entry level role, reporting into the Sales Operations Manager, dedicated to supporting the Account Development Representative (ADR) team.

The focus of this role is hands-on: make the ADR team more effective at generating quality pipeline. The analyst will work alongside ADRs and their managers to improve the day-to-day prospecting workflow, develop outbound cadences and best practices, find efficiencies across the tech stack, build AI-assisted ways of working, partner with marketing on lead quality, and keep stale opportunities from going cold.

The ideal candidate is early in their career, energized by figuring out how work gets done and how it could be done better, and eager to learn modern go-to-market tools and AI alongside an experienced operations team.

**Your Impact:**
----------------

**Optimizing ADR processes and workflow**

* Learn the ADR workflow end to end, from lead assignment through to a qualified meeting, and document how it actually works today
* Identify the steps that slow ADRs down or produce low quality pipeline, and work with the ADR managers to simplify or remove them
* Maintain clear, current process documentation and enablement material so that expectations are consistent across the team

**Developing cadences and outbound best practices**

* Build and maintain outbound cadences and sequence templates in the sales engagement platform, in partnership with ADR leadership
* Track which cadences, messaging, and channel mixes are producing qualified meetings, and retire the ones that are not
* Capture what top performing ADRs do well and turn it into repeatable, documented best practice the whole team can follow

**Finding efficiencies across the tech stack**

* Learn the tools the ADR team uses day to day, including Salesforce.com, SalesLoft, and prospecting data sources such as ZoomInfo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Look for redundant tools, unused licenses, manual steps, and integration gaps, and recommend practical fixes
* Serve as a first point of contact for ADR questions about how the tools work, escalating configuration changes to the senior operations team

**Developing an AI workflow to generate pipeline**

* Design and pilot an AI-assisted prospecting workflow, using tools such as Microsoft Copilot and the AI features built into the existing stack, to support account research, account prioritization, and outbound messaging
* Test and refine prompts and templates with a small group of ADRs, measure whether they lead to more qualified conversations, and document what works
* Roll the proven workflow out to the wider ADR team and keep it current as new AI capabilities become available

**Reviewing MQL quality and scoring methodology**

* Partner with the ADR team and marketing to review the quality of marketing qualified leads and how they are being scored
* Gather structured feedback from ADRs on which lead sources and score thresholds convert, and bring that feedback back to marketing
* Help refine scoring criteria and routing so ADRs spend their time on the leads most likely to become pipeline

**Following up on stale opportunities**

* Monitor opportunities that have gone quiet or passed their expected close date and flag them to the ADR team and account executives
* Coordinate re-engagement cadences for stalled and closed lost opportunities so that earlier pipeline investment is not wasted

-----------------

* 0-2 years of experience in sales operations, marketing operations, account development, or a related business function; internship experience will be considered.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort working alongside a fast-moving, high-volume team.
* Disciplined attention to detail, highly organized, and thorough.
* Ability to prioritize and manage several assignments at once with support from a hands-on manager.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Creative AI
new_jobs.description:
**Help creative teams turn Comfy workflows into everyday production.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Comfy is the open, modular platform for visual AI. Artists, studios, developers, and enterprise teams use ComfyUI to build workflows across image, video, audio, and 3D—with control over the models, parameters, and processes behind their work.

We’re hiring our first Customer Success Manager to help our most strategic customers adopt Comfy, get into production, and grow with us.

You’ll work directly with customers while building the foundation of our customer success function. That means leading onboarding, teaching teams how to use Comfy effectively, resolving adoption barriers, and defining how we track customer health, manage renewals, and identify expansion opportunities.

This is a hands-on role for someone who knows ComfyUI, understands how creative and technical teams work, and has built customer relationships that translate into lasting adoption.

**What you’ll own**
-------------------

**Customer onboarding and adoption**

* Lead customers from initial goals to working production workflows, with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Run practical onboarding sessions, workshops, and product deep dives for artists, technical leads, and enterprise teams.
* Help customers navigate workflows, models, custom nodes, and deployment options across ComfyUI, Comfy Cloud, and Comfy API.
* Identify where adoption stalls, troubleshoot the underlying issues, and partner with engineering or our Forward Deployed Creatives when deeper implementation work is needed.

**Customer relationships and growth**

* Own the ongoing relationship with strategic accounts, from onboarding through renewal and expansion.
* Build success plans around each customer’s production goals, stakeholders, and definition of value.
* Recognize risk early and take action on low usage, unresolved technical issues, or changing customer priorities.
* Identify opportunities to expand adoption across teams, workflows, and use cases.

**The customer success function**

* Define which customers need dedicated attention and where education, documentation, and self-service can scale.
* Build practical playbooks for onboarding, account management, escalations, renewals, and expansion.
* Establish customer health signals and success metrics, including time to first value, adoption, retention, and account growth.
* Turn recurring customer needs into clear product feedback and work with product and engineering to prioritize improvements.
* Help shape and grow the CS team as the business develops.

**What you bring**
------------------

* **Hands-on ComfyUI experience.** You’ve built workflows, encountered problems, and worked through them. You can explain your choices and help someone else learn.
* Experience owning customer relationships at a technical SaaS, developer tools, creative software, or AI company—typically five or more years.
* A track record of driving onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion, with concrete examples of your contribution.
* Experience building processes in an early-stage or rapidly growing business.
* The ability to earn trust with both creative and technical stakeholders, from a production artist or VFX supervisor to a pipeline lead or CTO.
* Comfort discussing models, custom nodes, APIs, and workflow dependencies. Coding experience is helpful; practical technical judgment is essential.
* Clear communication, sound prioritization, and the ability to make progress when requirements are still taking shape.

Experience in film, VFX, gaming, advertising, design, or other creative production environments is especially relevant. So is experience helping an open-source community adopt a commercial product.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

Customers reach useful production outcomes faster. Their teams can operate and adapt workflows confidently. Adoption risks surface early, and renewals and expansion follow from demonstrated value.

Inside Comfy, you’ll establish a repeatable customer success approach that helps us serve more customers while keeping a close understanding of their needs.

**About Comfy**
---------------

Comfy gives visual professionals the building blocks to connect models, processing steps, and outputs on an inspectable canvas. Workflows can be adapted, reproduced, and shared—from an artist’s local setup to a team’s production pipeline.

We’re a small team based in San Francisco, working closely across product, engineering, and go-to-market. We value ownership, technical curiosity, direct communication, and people who care about what customers are building.

Explore Comfy, our GitHub, and our blog.

**How to apply**
----------------

Share your resume and a ComfyUI workflow or project you’ve built. Tell us what problem it solves, what you learned, and what you would improve.

Include a brief example of a customer success process you built or significantly improved, and the outcome it produced.

Compensation Range: $180K - $225K

**Are you ready to Level Up?**  
  
**Join our growing team as a Customer Success Manager**  
  
**About the role**  
As a Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of property management customers and are responsible for their retention, satisfaction, and growth. You work with Sales, Support, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, and Marketing to make sure customers get real value from Track. We are growing, and customers are leaning on us more every year to help them get the most out of the platform, including our AI-driven features.  
  
**What you will do**  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for your customers and guide them through adoption and their overall success journey
* Keep customers with us by learning their goals and delivering solutions that meet them
* Spot churn risk early using AI-powered health signals, and prioritize outreach across your portfolio
* Run regular check-ins, business reviews, and product feedback sessions, and show customers new features and best practices
* Keep customer platforms up to date and well configured, and recommend changes that improve performance
* Help customers adopt AI-driven features in Track, and recommend automation that cuts manual work during business reviews
* Partner with Sales on renewals, contract negotiations, and expansion, with Support on Tier 3 escalations, with Professional Services on training and configuration, and with Product and Engineering by bringing customer feedback into discovery calls

  
**What you will bring**  

* Bachelor's degree and/or 3+ years of directly related experience
* Working knowledge of the vacation rental or short-term rental industry
* Experience working with executive-level clients
* Daily use of AI tools (like Claude, ChatGPT, or built-in platform AI) to increase your capacity and output quality. This is a must, not a nice-to-have.
* Ability to explain AI-driven product features in plain language to non-technical property managers and owners
* Strong communication, organization, and prioritization skills
* Project management experience is a plus

  
**You will thrive here if**  

* You can keep a full portfolio moving at once and decide who needs you most this week based on health signals, not just who emails loudest
* You are comfortable in a room with a vacation rental company's executives and can turn technical capabilities into practical wins for their properties
* You like being the connector between customers and our internal teams, and you follow through until the issue is resolved

  
**Compensation**  
The expected starting base salary range for this role is $65,000 to $75,000, plus eligibility for a 10% annual incentive tied to company performance. Final compensation is based on relevant skills, experience, education, and geographic location.  
  
**About Track**  
Track is an end-to-end SaaS and Service Operating Platform for short term rental. For more than two decades we have helped hospitality professionals achieve digital transformation and operational excellence, anchored by our flagship Track Property Management System.  
  
Our single-vendor ecosystem gives growing vacation rental companies the enterprise-class tools they need to scale, backed by 70+ integration partners, a growing suite of native features, and AI-driven tools that sharpen pricing, distribution, and guest communication. Track is proud to be named an Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Company in America and a People's Choice Award winner.  
  
**Our core values**  
These are the behaviors that shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our customers.  

* Serve Others: nurturing growth to help others succeed
* Grit: taking ownership and never giving up on what matters most
* Create the Future: innovating to disrupt the status quo

  
**Benefits and perks**  

* Full medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible paid time off
* Health Savings Account with up to a $2,000 annual match, plus Flexible Spending Accounts
* Up to $900 a year in Wellness Rewards
* Retirement plan with employer match
* Unlimited access to professional training and development

* Flexible work environment, plus a $150 quarterly gift for personal use

new_jobs.title: Sales & Operations Leader
new_jobs.description:
**Role summary**

We are hiring a part-time Sales & Operations Leader to run the sales and operations staff across three businesses: BICS (IT and analytics consulting), Evolve (digital marketing), and S&N Investment Properties (real estate). The people doing the work are already in place; this Leader keeps them on process, verifies execution, and drives revenue, close rate, and customer engagement heading into 2027.

**Job responsibilities**

· **Strategic execution:** Translate founder and leadership ideas into a defined objective, owner, next step, timeline, and practical measure of progress. Surface tradeoffs when priorities change.

· **Sales leadership and revenue operations:** Review HubSpot visibility, opportunity ownership, follow-up and stalled deals. Join selected sales calls to observe performance, give specific feedback, coach the sales team, and improve discovery and handoffs. The assigned salesperson remains accountable for the call and follow-up.

· **Marketing and outreach:** Drive marketing and outreach to existing BICS and Evolve clients and selected prospects. With no dedicated marketing team, define the audience, offer, message, channels and next steps; personally build or coordinate the materials and campaigns; and assess what generates useful conversations.

· **RFP and proposal leadership:** Review RFPs for fit, requirements, credibility and quality. Serve as the point person gathering relevant project examples, results, references, technical input and other source material from delivery and leadership so proposals are sufficiently supported. Coordinate revisions with the proposal writer and pursuit owner.

· **Cross-company coordination:** Connect people and decisions across BICS and Evolve when an initiative spans sales, marketing, delivery, finance, or administration. Identify work without a clear owner.

· **Onboarding and handoffs:** Coordinate the operational pieces of new team member and client onboarding, including access, documentation, role expectations and handoffs to the assigned owners. Confirm that outstanding setup steps have an owner and are completed.

· **Operational blocker resolution:** Act as the liaison among administrative, accounting, IT and other support staff to identify and resolve blockers. Bring the founder a concise decision or escalation when the issue exceeds the role’s authority or available resources.

· **Client engagement:** Maintain direct contact with clients when an introduction, relationship check-in, service concern, expansion conversation or cross-team coordination would help move work forward. Bring the appropriate sales or delivery owner into follow-up.

· **Operational improvement:** Assess workflows, staffing arrangements, tools, AI, and automation opportunities. Move approved changes into use with an owner, basic validation, and follow-through.

· **Delivery and PM enablement:** Partner with delivery leadership to strengthen handoffs, project visibility, and practical PM standards without creating a large training burden. Delivery leadership retains project and PM management.

**Required traits and skills**

· **Hands on:** Willing and able to do the work, learn unfamiliar technology, and build new tools or solutions when the business needs them.

· **Comfort with ambiguity:** Works from incomplete context, asks targeted questions, checks assumptions, and brings back a concrete recommendation rather than waiting for a complete brief.

· **Independent judgment and resilience:** Makes practical decisions with incomplete information, explains the reasoning, and remains steady when feedback changes the direction. Adjusts and keeps work moving without relying on the founder for every next step.

· **Commercial and technical fluency:** Understands a small technology services firm well enough to connect client needs, delivery capacity, proposals, CRM activity, and profitability. Deep engineering expertise is unnecessary.

· **Independent follow-through:** Tracks commitments, closes loops across contractors and teams, escalates blockers early, and adapts when circumstances change.

· **Pragmatic systems judgment:** Uses lightweight routines and selective automation to improve reliability without imposing unnecessary meetings, documentation, or software.

Pay: $50.00 - $75.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote
